# Listening-test and benchmark sentences (phase-03 plan, P3-T6). One per line; # starts a comment.
# Greetings with Indian names
Hello, am I speaking with Rahul Sharma?
Hello, am I speaking with Priya Iyer?
Hi Venkatesh, I'm an AI recruitment assistant calling on behalf of HCLTech about a Backend Developer role. Is this a good time for a quick five-minute conversation?
# Cities and companies
Great, thank you. It's a QA Engineer position with Infosys based in Bengaluru.
Are you currently working at TCS, Wipro or HCLTech?
Would you be open to relocating to Gurgaon, Noida or Hyderabad?
# Numbers
Got it. Just to confirm, your current CTC is 12.5 lakhs per annum, is that right?
And your notice period is 60 days?
Thanks. Just to confirm, you have 5.5 years of experience, a current CTC of 12.5 lakhs, an expected CTC of 18 lakhs and a notice period of 60 days. Is that correct?
# Times
Sure, we'll call you back tomorrow at 5 PM. Thank you, goodbye!
Sure, we'll call you back on Thursday, 19 November at 5:30 PM. Thank you, goodbye!
# A long question
Could you tell me a little about your current role, the main technologies you work with day to day, and what kind of team you would like to join next?
# Short acknowledgements
Okay.
Got it.
Thanks, Rahul.
